channels: all 64 EEG channels; original reference retained
reference: Independent EDF digital-to-physical decoding; explicitly configured MNE IIR filtering and Welch; independent piecewise-linear band integration. Shared SciPy numerical routines are acknowledged.
gates: finite processed samples, PSD, RMS and band powers
raw files absent from repository and release
interpretation: Small convenience subset; computational consistency on real EEG, not clinical validation, artifact-classifier performance, or population inference. Task runs include both rest and task intervals; no event-level model. No real EMG validation.
publication: Only hashes, protocol, and derived summary statistics are published with dataset attribution; no human waveforms, EDF headers, annotations, or recordings.
